title: Hong Kong crypto giant HashKey merges regional exchange into one
summary: Hong Kong’s HashKey will unify its crypto exchange branches, with users from its Hong Kong, Global, Singapore and Middle East regions using the same platform.

title: Rate path still divides investors: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
summary: Bitcoin traders prepared to navigate a slew of volatility catalysts as US inflation data and US-Iran war triggers keep risk-assets in an unpredictable state.

title: Binance disappears from Google Play in certain EU countries
summary: Binance’s Android app is unavailable on Google Play in some EU markets amid scrutiny over MiCA compliance.

title: USDC issuer Circle to acquire nearly 1,000 IBM blockchain patents
summary: IBM’s blockchain portfolio includes more than 680 patent families and nearly 1,000 issued patents worldwide, with a particular focus in supply chain applications.

title: Strategy sells MSTR shares, buys back $25M in STRC preferred stock
summary: Strategy raised $544.5 million through MSTR stock sales as it repurchased $25 million of STRC shares and expanded its US dollar reserve to $3.75 billion.

title: BNY Mellon unit joins MiCA register as ESMA adds 15 providers
summary: BNY Mellon’s European subsidiary joined the MiCA register as ESMA added 15 CASPs, including banks and crypto platforms, in the third post-deadline update.

title: Brazilian police bust cocaine traffickers in crypto-linked transnational probe
summary: Brazilian police suspect the group of shipping around 6.5 metric tons of cocaine and laundering billions in Brazilian reals through crypto-enabled illicit money brokers.

title: Coinbase CEO touts agentic finance as Base tops 100M AI payments
summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong says AI agents will expand crypto adoption, pointing to Base, USDC and x402 as key pieces of agentic finance.

title: Triple-A confirms treasury-wallet breach after losses reach $11.8M
summary: The stablecoin payments company said client funds were unaffected and that the financial impact would be absorbed through its treasury reserves.

title: BitMart withdrawals appear to slow following wind-down announcement
summary: Users reported withdrawal delays and freeze notices as wallets attributed to BitMart fell to about $69 million and its BMX token extended an 81.5% weekly decline.
